sources.title: Reality is optional - pika.art
sources.snippet: Our Pikaformance model is now available on web: hyper-real expressions, synced to any sound. Make your images sing, speak, rap, bark, and more—with near real time generation speed.

sources.title: Pika Labs - AI Video Generation Platform
sources.snippet: Pika is a video generation platform built on a proprietary AI video model developed in-house. Feed it a prompt, image, audio, or video, and it produces a new clip — animating, modifying, lip-syncing, or transforming based on your direction.
